cast: SPINE ode. Refrain: "Let me introduce you.". Features: david-kobrosky, mikaela, maya, sub-agent, supercharged-laptop. David Kobrosky has one craft and he has never changed it: he notices who is standing alone at the edge of a room and connects them to where they belong. He taught software the same instinct and sold the company. Then the tools changed, a new kind of person became possible, and David became one of the clearest living examples of it: a hyperagent on Anthropic's Applied AI team, looking after ninety startups at once, waking founders up to the opportunity of the age. An ode to a friend, and an explanation of what a hyperagent is, and a forecast of what people like him will do next.
